Endocrinologist - Remote Telehealth
North Carolina license required

Any 2 days per week - 8 hr shifts

Job Overview
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Endocrinologist to join our healthcare team. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in diagnosing and treating endocrine disorders, with a focus on providing exceptional patient care. This role involves working in a collaborative environment, ensuring comprehensive treatment plans for patients with various endocrine-related conditions.

Duties - Endocrinologist Telehealth

Conduct thorough evaluations and assessments of patients with endocrine disorders.
Develop and implement individualized treatment plans based on clinical findings and patient needs.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including specialists in cardiology, immunology, and infection control, to provide holistic patient care.
Telehealth

Qualifications - Remote Telehealth Endocrinologist

Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution.
Board certification in Endocrinology.
Strong clinical skills with experience in patient care.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with patients and healthcare professionals.
Commitment to providing high-quality care and improving patient outcomes in endocrinology.

Join us in making a difference in the lives of our patients by providing expert endocrinological care in Telehealth healthcare setting.

Pay: Up to $115.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
